def calculate_m_S5(S5):
    """
    Calculates m(S5), the minimum value of max_{pairs} |e/h - g/f| 
    over all 4-element subsets S4 of S5.
    """
    if len(S5) != 5:
        raise ValueError("Input must be a set of 5 numbers.")

    min_M_S4 = float('inf')
    
    # 1. Iterate over all 5 subsets S4
    for S4_tuple in itertools.combinations(S5, 4):
        S4 = list(S4_tuple)
        
        # S4 has 4 elements: n1, n2, n3, n4
        n1, n2, n3, n4 = S4
        
        # 2. Find M(S4): the maximum ratio discrepancy for this S4 over all partitions
        max_Q_S4 = 0.0
        
        # There are 3 ways to partition 4 elements into two pairs:
        # P1: {n1, n2}, {n3, n4}
        # P2: {n1, n3}, {n2, n4}
        # P3: {n1, n4}, {n2, n3}
        
        partitions = [
            ((n1, n2), (n3, n4)),
            ((n1, n3), (n2, n4)),
            ((n1, n4), (n2, n3))
        ]
        
        for (p1, p2) in partitions:
            n_a, n_b = p1  # First pair {e, f}
            n_c, n_d = p2  # Second pair {g, h}
            
            # For each partition, we must check all 4 ways to assign roles (e, f, g, h)
            # based on the structure |e/h - g/f|.
            
            # Case 1: e=n_a, f=n_b, g=n_c, h=n_d
            q1 = abs(n_a/n_d - n_c/n_b)
            # Case 2: e=n_b, f=n_a, g=n_c, h=n_d

            # Case 3: e=n_a, f=n_b, g=n_d, h=n_c

            # Case 4: e=n_b, f=n_a, g=n_d, h=n_c

            max_Q_S4 = max(max_Q_S4, current_max_Q)
